question: What changed in the RRCReconfiguration procedure for mobility, including L1/L2 triggered mobility (LTM)?
note: LTM (L1/L2 triggered mobility) is new in Rel-18 38.331; 5.3.5.x gains LTM configuration/execution subclauses absent in Rel-17.
author: seed

question: How did NTN (non-terrestrial network) support in RRC change, e.g. for discontinuous coverage and NTN-specific SIBs?
note: Rel-17 introduced NTN (SIB19 etc.); Rel-18 extends it (discontinuous coverage, NTN enhancements) — text differs across releases.
author: seed

question: What changed in system information acquisition and the set of SIBs the UE can receive?
note: Rel-18 adds new SIBs (e.g. for network energy saving, NTN enhancements, MUSIM) to 5.2.2.x — SIB list and acquisition text differ.
author: seed

question: What changed for multi-SIM (MUSIM) operation, such as MUSIM gaps and leaving RRC_CONNECTED?
note: Rel-17 introduced MUSIM gaps/leave indication; Rel-18 enhances MUSIM (gap priorities, capability handling) — clause text differs.
author: seed

question: What changed in UE measurement reporting configuration, for example new event triggers or measurement types?
note: Rel-18 adds measurement events/reporting for LTM and NTN and altitude-based events - 5.5.x text differs from Rel-17.
author: seed
